decision: Prospective independent-process same-workload selection for both sealed caps; no parameter scan or favorable-timing retry. Start only after affected lifecycle checks complete.
protocol: Fresh process, host/device ownership preflight and successful cache drop per cell;60s between8Kand40K. Same pinned exact requests and output/work oracle. Temperature<=85C, fixed GPU min/max/current1300500000Hz,8GiB reserve, complete route/capacity, normal exit. Missing strict evidence invalidates selection without erasing independently valid correctness.
selection: For each cap and bucket min(candidate Decode)/max(nonMTP Decode)>=1.5. Report both observations, medians and all joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total metrics. Candidate Prefill must not regress>3% against same-cap v122; MTP draft initialization overhead vs nonMTP remains separately visible.
completion_boundary: This selects the architecture only. Installation, full affected delivery attestation and explicit final goal audit remain required.
early_stop: After each complete protocol-valid cell, reject and stop remaining cells if an observed conservative min(candidate)/max(native) is already below1.5, or Prefill violates3% guard. Further observations cannot reverse that worst-case failure. Preserve every completed cell; no retries.
